lightIdle: Kwala aterese epe ya webosaete. Re tlhatlhoba lenaane la rona la ditshosetso, sebopego, go eka merka, DNS le karabo ya jaanong. Mo Ema: tswa, netefatsa ka kanaleng ya semmuso e o setseng o e tshepile, mme o begele fa o rata.
lightLimited: E phepa e raya gore diteko tse di dirilweng ga di a naya tsiboso e e maatla — ga se tsholofetso ya gore saete e sireletsegile.
privacyNote: Ka tlwaelo: ga go bolokwe sepe. Teko ya diphoso e thusa go baakanya mathata a sethekeniki fela — le ka mohla e se aterese, gape le ka mohla e se go phasaladiwa.
privacyOff: O se ka wa boloka le ka mohla
privacyPolicyIntro: Sediriswa sa buusdo Cybersecurity Service Tool (mola wa dihlahiswa tsa Buusdo — sehlahiswa se se farologaneng) se go thusa go tlhatlhoba aterese ya webosaete pele o e tshepa. Diteko di dirisa matshwao a rona le lenaane la rona la ditshosetso le le tlhokomelwang. Tsebe eno ke kitsiso ya sephiri ya sehlahiswa ya webosaete, katoloso ya sebati, le app ya teseke.
privacyPolicyWhatBody: Fa o dira teko, aterese e o e tsenyang e dirwa mo seveng ya buusdo go sekaseka sebopego, go e bapisa le lenaane la rona la ditshosetso, mme ka boikgetho go lekola go fitlhelela ga jaanong (DNS / HTTP). Ga re romele di-URL tse di tlhatlhobilweng kwa Google Safe Browsing kgotsa kwa di-API tse dingwe tsa botumo jwa motho wa boraro, mme ga re rekise datha ya teko.
privacyPolicyStoreBody: Ka tlwaelo: ga go bolokwe sepe. O ka tlhopha go boloka mo sedirisweng se fela (lenaane la thibelo/tshepo, hisitori ya teko ka boikgetho) mo sebatling, katolosong, kgotsa app ya teseke. Teko ya diphoso ya thekgo e akaretsa motswedi le mofuta wa tshosetso fela — le ka mohla e se aterese e e tletseng, gape le ka mohla e se go phasaladiwa kgotsa papatso.
privacyPolicyAccountTitle: Ga go na kgolagano ya akhaonto ya maru
privacyPolicyAccountBody: buusdo ga e neye akhaonto ya maru kgotsa kgolagano ya lenaane magareng ga didiriswa. Lenaane la gago la thibelo/tshepo le nna mo sedirisweng se. Le sutise ka go romela kwa ntle kgotsa go tsenya JSON kgotsa QR ya shield-lists-v1, kgotsa o golaganye ka bowena faele ya shield-backup.json ya teseke (USB, Drive, Syncthing).
privacyPolicyContactBody: Ka dipotso tsa sephiri kgotsa tsa sehlahiswa, ikgolaganye le modiri wa go tlhoma ga gago ga buusdo ka imeile ya gagwe ya semmuso kgotsa kanale ya thekgo (motho kgotsa mokgatlho o o tsamaisang Cloudflare Worker). Tlhopha aterese eo ya semmuso e o e itseng — e seng mogala kgotsa imeile e e gatilweng mo saeteng e o e tlhatlhobang. O se ka wa manamisa dipholo tsa teko tse di botlhoko mo dikanaleng tsa setšhaba.
privacyPolicyLimitsBody: Ga go na go rutlolola TLS — HTTPS CONNECT ke leina la moamogedi fela; ga go na setifikeiti sa MITM. Ga go na go bolaya ditirelo — diporokeramo tse di tsamayang di tswelela. Difolara tsa tsamaiso di begwa fela — /usr, /etc, ditsela tsa tsamaiso tsa Windows, le Program Files ga di kitla di sutisiwa kgotsa di baakanywa. Ga go na enjene ya AV kgotsa ya ditshwao, gape ga go na go tshwara diphasewete kgotsa hisitori ya go praosa.

blockListsOfflinePath: Tsela magareng ga didiriswa: romela kwa ntle kgotsa tsenya JSON kgotsa QR ya shield-lists-v1 mo katolosong kgotsa app ya teseke. Teseke e ka golaganya gape shield-backup.json ka USB, Drive, kgotsa Syncthing — ga go na akhaonto ya maru.

listsOfflineDesktopBody: App ya teseke e boloka lenaane jaaka shield-backup.json mo foltareng ya datha ya yone. O ka golaganya foltara eo ka Syncthing, Drive, kgotsa USB. Fa didiriswa di le pedi di kwala ka nako e le nngwe, romela kwa ntle gape go tswa mo sedirisweng se o se tshepang mme o tsenye mo go se sengwe.

levelCautionNote: Go bonwe go sa tlhomama go go botlhokwa kgotsa matshwao a tsiboso.
levelLowEvidenceLabel: Bosupi jwa kotsi jo bo kwa tlase
levelLowEvidenceNote: Ga go na tshosetso e e itsiweng e e bonweng mo metsweding e e tlhatlhobilweng.
levelUnknownNote: Ga go na bosupi jo bo lekaneng go fitlha tshwetso e e tlhomameng.
reputationNoKnownMatch: GA GO NA TSHWANTSHO E E ITSIWENG
recommendationLeaveAndBlock: Tswa mme o thibele domeine eno (mo katolosong kgotsa app ya teseke)
desktopBlockNeedOpen: Bula app ya teseke ya buusdo pele (localhost:3010), mme o leke gape.
evidenceKnownThreatTitle: Letshwao la tshosetso e e itsiweng
evidenceKnownThreatDetail: Aterese eno e tshwana le lenaane la ditshosetso la buusdo.
evidenceNoMatchTitle: Ga go na tshosetso e e itsiweng mo lenaaneng
evidenceNoMatchDetail: Ga go na tshosetso e e itsiweng e e bonweng mo lenaaneng la rona. Seno ga se tlhomamise gore saete e sireletsegile.
evidenceUnknownReputationDetail: Lenaane la rona ga le neye maduo a a siameng kgotsa a a maswe.
evidenceProviderUnavailableTitle: Lenaane la ditshosetso ga le fitlhelege
evidenceProviderUnavailableDetail: Lenaane la rona ga le a kgona go buisiwa. Diteko tsa sebopego le tsa jaanong di tsereletse.
evidenceIdentityMatchTitle: Domeine e tshwana le mokgatlho o o itsiweng
evidenceIdentityMatchDetail: Domeine e e ka kwadiswang e tshwana le {name}. Seno ga se reye gore saete e sireletsegile.
evidenceIdentityMismatchTitle: E lebega jaaka mokgatlho o o itsiweng, mme domeine ga e tshwane
evidenceIdentityMismatchDetail: Aterese e lebega e golagane le {name}, mme domeine e e laolang ke {domain}.
evidenceMisleadingSubdomainTitle: Letshwao la domeine e e kwa tlase e e timetsang
evidenceMisleadingSubdomainDetail: Leina le le tshwanang le mokgatlho le tla pele ga domeine e e laolang {domain}.
evidenceLookalikeTitle: Letshwao la domeine e e tshwanang
evidenceLookalikeDetail: Domeine eno e tshwana le domeine e e itsiweng. Go tshwana ke letshwao, e seng bosupi jwa tsietso.
evidencePunycodeTitle: Domeine ya dinaga e e khoutuilweng
evidencePunycodeDetail: Aterese e na le punycode. E ka nna ya siama, mme ditlhaka tse di tshwanang di tlhoka kelotlhoko.
evidenceHttpDetail: Tshedimosetso e e romelwang ka HTTP e ka senolwa mo tseleng.
evidenceSensitivePathTitle: Tsela ya tsebe e e botlhoko
evidenceSensitivePathDetail: Tsela e kaya gore tsebe e ka kopa tshedimosetso e e botlhoko. Netefatsa domeine ka go ikemela.
evidenceDnsOkDetail: Teko ya jaanong e fitlhetse moamogedi.
evidenceDnsFailDetail: Moamogedi ga a a araba. Saete e ka nna ya kwadiwa phoso kgotsa e sa fitlhelege.
evidenceRedirectChainDetail: Kopo e latetse phuduso e le nngwe kgotsa go feta.
evidenceCrossRedirectDetail: Aterese e huduseditswe kwa domeineng e nngwe e e ka kwadiswang.
evidenceTlsFailDetail: HTTPS ga e a kgona go netefadiwa. O se ka wa tsenya tshedimosetso e e botlhoko.
evidenceIpHostDetail: Saete e fitlhelelwa ka IP mo boemong jwa leina le le tlwaelegileng la domeine.
evidenceRiskyTldTitle: Bokhutlo jwa domeine jo bo sa tlwaelegang
evidenceRiskyTldDetail: Bokhutlo jono bo dirisiwa gantsi mo matsholong a tsietso. Bo le nosi ga bo tlhomamise kotsi.
evidenceDeepSubdomainTitle: Ketane ya domeine e e kwa tlase e e sa tlwaelegang
evidenceDeepSubdomainDetail: Diketane tse ditelele tsa domeine e e kwa tlase ka dinako dingwe di dirisiwa go lebega di le semmuso.
evidenceSecretQueryDetail: Aterese e baya sephiri mo query. Boleng ga bo a bolokwa.
evidenceProbeTimeoutTitle: Teko ya jaanong e feletswe ke nako
evidenceProbeTimeoutDetail: Saete ga e a araba ka nako.
evidenceHttpsLimitTitle: HTTPS ga e tlhomamise boitshupo kgotsa tshepo
evidenceHttpsLimitDetail: HTTPS e sireletsa kgolagano, mme ga e tlhomamise gore ke mang yo o tsamaisang saete kgotsa gore e a ikanyega.
evidenceScopeLimitDetail: Re sekaseka aterese ka lenaane la rona, go tshwana ga merka, DNS, go fitlhelela le diphuduso. Ga re romele URL kwa ditirelong tsa motho wa boraro.
evidenceUserBlockDetail: Moamogedi yo o mo lenaaneng la gago la botho (katoloso kgotsa app). Saete ga e a boloka lenaane.
limitationFalsePosNeg: Matshwao a ka ntsha ditshwao tse di fosagetseng kgotsa a fose kotsi e e teng.
limitationNoContent: Teko eno ga e sekaseke diteng tsa tsebe mme ga e tlhomamise gore ke mang yo o laolang domeine.
limitationIdentityNotSafe: Go tshwana ga boitshupo ga go solofetse gore kgato nngwe le nngwe mo saeteng e sireletsegile.
limitationNoThirdParty: Di-URL ga di romelwe kwa Google Safe Browsing kgotsa ditirelong tse dingwe tsa botumo tsa motho wa boraro.

probeBlockedGenericTitle: Saete e thibetse teko e e itiragalelang
probeBlockedGenericDetail: Go amogetswe HTTP {status}. Saete e thibetse kgotsa e fokoditse teko eno — seo ga se bosupi jwa tsietso. Leka aterese mo sebatling se se tlwaelegileng fa go tlhokega.
faqCommonIntro: Dikarabo tse dikhutshwane ka se buusdo e se dirang le se e sa se dire — di thusa pele o tshepa maduo a Ema.
